notes.title: Update #? : I read everything!
notes.content:
Small update thanks to your feedback, Thank you :)


[b]What has changed here???[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the gun shot location
[*] Fixed how the main character was holding a gun
[*] Added some visual objects to the location
[/list]

Write your reviews, suggestions, ideas. We read everything :)

And also come to our [url=https://discord.gg/WH6VjFWyZ8]Discord server[/url]
And also our [url=https://twitter.com/whowear22701559]Twitter (X)[/url]

notes.title: Update 14.88 V2

tags.feature: [*] One of Stalin's test subjects received a new mutation;

tags.bug: [*] Lighting has been fixed (the rays of the communists covered the face of cute Eva, now they are not so bright);

tags.feature: [*] Now, when you start the game, a hint will be visible if the WIFE has not yet realized that you need to talk to the HUSBAND;
[*] Now you will be told what to do near the legendary TIGRRRR tank;
[*] Super-soldiers came to help Stalin, be careful;
[*] Aircraft arrived to help the communists;

tags.balance_change: [*] The duration of the dialog box has been increased;

notes.title: Update v14.88

tags.feature: [*] Improved global illumination in the game;

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug when the character was tired and did not want to get up. Now at death, you will be reborn again;
[*] Removed places that you do not need to see;
[*] Made a number of minor improvements to the process;

tags.feature: [*] We have removed the free camera, in the future we may return it, or maybe not, let's look at your behavior.
